query:
SELECT id, request_number, status, urgency_level, director_approvals
FROM purchaseRequests
WHERE request_number = 'SOL-2026-0170';

SELECT action, from_status, to_status, created_at, comment
FROM approvalHistory
WHERE request_id = (SELECT id FROM purchaseRequests WHERE request_number = 'SOL-2026-0170')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
